referencia_alap.4 Képes Referencia Beállítás:
Use Reference @Image 1 for her face and head: keep her exact face, facial features, profile, eye color, skin tone, hair color, and hairstyle. Use Reference @Image 2 for her body: keep her exact body proportions and physical build. It shouldn't have an artificial intelligence feel; it should be lifelike and natural.

Use Reference @Image 3 for the environment: precisely copy all background details, including the architectural/landscape layout, spatial composition, textures, colors, background objects, foliage, and surrounding elements down to the finest detail.

Use Reference @Image 4 for her outfit: replicate the exact clothing items, fabric material, fabric texture, seams, fit, cuts, transparency levels, folds, and colors. Every detail of the outfit must match Reference @Image 4 precisely.

Remove all jewelry, text, and watermarks.
